description: Happy path (post-#244 canonical): Approved verdict where Requestor is the reviewer and Requestee is the PR author (= branch author per charter Direction table). Branch is A.Virtanen/...; Requestor is Nadia Khoury (reviewer), Requestee is Aino Virtanen (PR author = branch author). Inverted heuristic compares Requestor.lastname to branch-author.lastname; Khoury != Virtanen → no swap, allow.
command:
gh pr comment 42 --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Requestor: Nadia Khoury
Requestee: Aino Virtanen
RequestOrReplied: Approved
TechDebt: none
EOF
)"
